title: Choose the landing-page world
question: Which world should replace the current homepage and Story Mode art direction?

options.label: The Impossible Observatory
options.lineage: Monumental scientific instruments and celestial observatories
options.body: A luminous stone-and-brass world where 64 glass paths converge through an enormous orrery. Most iconic, spatial, and premium; risk is becoming too fantastical unless evidence labels stay disciplined.

options.label: The Branching City
options.lineage: Architectural models, transit maps, and illuminated urban systems
options.body: A precise miniature city where unequal districts and branching routes make survivor selection immediately understandable. Clearest metaphor; risk is drifting toward generic futuristic visualization.

options.label: The Living Ledger
options.lineage: Mechanical archives, indexing machines, and museum conservation labs
options.body: A tactile kinetic archive where thousands of biography records move through branching rails and one becomes visible. Most credible and editorial; risk is less expansive than the other worlds.
